title: The Great Hunt: Nightmother

texts.details:
You carry yourself like one who has taken a first great beast. Then you are ready to be humbled by a second.

The boar and the spider wait or charge. A cat does neither. A cat chooses the moment, and the moment is always when you have looked away. The moonstalkers of this coast are the finest stalkers in the north.

Take eight of the sires in the woods here. Learn to feel when you are being watched. Then go east, up into the hills. There is a matriarch there the Sentinels call Nightmother. If you see her first, $N, you will be the first who has.
texts.objectives: Kill 8 Moonstalker Sires in the woods of Darkshore and then Nightmother, in the hills east of the road. Return to Sentinel Tysha Moonblade.
texts.progress: If the forest goes quiet, she already knows where you are.
texts.completion:
Nightmother is taken. I did not think to see it.

You will have noticed what the long stalk did to your companion. A beast that waits beside you for hours without a kill grows restless, then sullen. The second lesson of the Hunt is for them, not for you: a hunter keeps the animal content through the waiting. Feed it before it asks. Rest when it rests.

You have the way of it now. It will stay with you. When you have thirty seasons behind you, seek out Kinelory in the Arathi Highlands. She watches the raptors there, and the third beast is hers to show you.

idea: The Great Hunt, level 20 (Alliance): the great cat. Gives the perk of a pet that stays content longer. Invented: Nightmother.
